main.bio: With over 10 years of experience in crafting seamless user interfaces and 4 years tackling backend challenges, I bring a full-stack approach to every project. My toolkit includes modern technologies like TypeScript, Next.js, Prisma, Node.js, React, C#, .NET, and cloud services such as Azure, GCP, and AWS. I’ve worked extensively with complex data visualizations, charts, maps, and robust backend services. Beyond coding, I thrive in collaborative environments, excelling in communication and alignment with development teams. My passion for technology drives me to continually refine my skills and seek out the next challenge in the ever-evolving digital landscape.
